scenes.title: Can you find the missing boundaries?

sentences.en: Decode zero one zero, with no separators. What message did you receive?
sentences.zh: 解读没有分隔符的零一零。你收到的消息是什么？

sentences.en: Symbol A maps to zero, symbol B to zero one, and symbol C to one zero.
sentences.zh: 符号A映射为0，符号B映射为01，符号C映射为10。

sentences.en: Every symbol has a different label. Is that enough to recover the message?
sentences.zh: 每个符号都有不同的标签。这足以还原消息吗？

sentences.en: Read zero followed by one zero: that means A, then C.
sentences.zh: 读成零后接一零：意思是先 A，后 C。

sentences.en: Or read zero one followed by zero: that means B, then A.
sentences.zh: 也可以读成零一后接零：意思是先 B，后 A。

sentences.en: Two different messages produced exactly the same bits.
sentences.zh: 两条不同的消息产生了完全相同的比特。

sentences.en: A finite code assigns one finite string to each source symbol.
sentences.zh: 有限码为每个信源符号分配一个有限字符串。

sentences.en: For now, every codeword is nonempty.
sentences.zh: 现在假设每个码字都非空。

sentences.en: Different symbols receiving different codewords makes the code nonsingular.
sentences.zh: 不同符号获得不同码字时，这个码就是非奇异的。

sentences.en: Sequence encoding concatenates the words, removing their visible boundaries.
sentences.zh: 序列编码把码字连接起来，去掉可见的边界。

sentences.en: Nonsingularity answers a one-symbol question. It does not settle sequence boundaries.
sentences.zh: 非奇异性回答的是单个符号的问题，不能确定序列的边界。

sentences.en: Unique decodability means each valid encoded string has exactly one source-symbol parsing.
sentences.zh: 唯一可译表示每个合法编码串恰有一种信源符号解析。

sentences.en: Our three-word code fails that requirement, even though it is nonsingular.
sentences.zh: 我们的三码字码不满足这个要求，尽管它是非奇异的。

sentences.en: Remove C. The remaining words are zero and zero one. Zero still prefixes zero one.
sentences.zh: 去掉 C。剩下零和零一，零仍然是零一的前缀。

sentences.en: Must this smaller code also be ambiguous? Try decoding zero one zero one.
sentences.zh: 这个更小的码也一定有歧义吗？试着解读零一零一。

sentences.en: Each one must pair with its immediately preceding zero, forming a zero-one word.
sentences.zh: 每个一必须和紧邻它之前的零配对，组成零一码字。

sentences.en: Every zero left over is its own one-bit word. The pairs cannot overlap.
sentences.zh: 剩下的每个零各自成为一个单比特码字，这些配对不会重叠。

sentences.en: This forced rule recovers every boundary of every valid encoded string.
sentences.zh: 这条强制规则能找回每个合法编码串的全部边界。

sentences.en: So zero, zero one is uniquely decodable, despite not being prefix-free.
sentences.zh: 所以零、零一是唯一可译码，尽管它不是前缀码。

sentences.en: Prefix-free means no codeword is a prefix of a different codeword.
sentences.zh: 前缀码表示没有码字是另一个不同码字的前缀。

sentences.en: The repaired code uses zero for symbol A, one zero for symbol B, and one one for symbol C.
sentences.zh: 修复后的码对符号A使用0，对B使用10，对C使用11。

sentences.en: Now read zero one zero one one from left to right. Where can the decoder stop?
sentences.zh: 现在从左到右读零一零一一。解码器可以在哪里停下？

sentences.en: The first zero gives A. The next one zero gives B. The final one one gives C.
sentences.zh: 第一个零给出 A，接着的一零给出 B，最后的一一给出 C。

sentences.en: In the tree, each bit selects a branch. A codeword is a leaf.
sentences.zh: 在树中，每个比特选择一条分支，码字就是叶子。

sentences.en: At a leaf, output its symbol and restart from the root for the next word.
sentences.zh: 到达叶子就输出它的符号，然后从根开始解读下一个码字。

sentences.en: Why can a prefix code never give two different parsings?
sentences.zh: 为什么前缀码不可能产生两种不同的解析？

sentences.en: If two first words end at different places, the shorter word prefixes the longer one.
sentences.zh: 如果两个首码字在不同位置结束，较短的码字就是较长码字的前缀。

sentences.en: Prefix-free forbids that. The first word is forced; remove it and repeat.
sentences.zh: 前缀码禁止这种情况。因此首码字被唯一确定，去掉它后重复即可。

sentences.en: Therefore every prefix-free code is uniquely decodable.
sentences.zh: 因此，每个前缀码都是唯一可译码。

sentences.en: Every uniquely decodable code is nonsingular: even one-symbol messages must decode uniquely.
sentences.zh: 每个唯一可译码都是非奇异码：即使只有一个符号，也必须能唯一解码。

sentences.en: The reverse implications fail. We have a concrete counterexample for each.
sentences.zh: 反向推论不成立，两种情况都有具体反例。

sentences.en: Zero, zero one is uniquely decodable but not prefix-free.
sentences.zh: 零、零一唯一可译，但不是前缀码。

sentences.en: Zero, zero one, one zero is nonsingular but not uniquely decodable.
sentences.zh: 零、零一、一零非奇异，但不唯一可译。

sentences.en: Prefix codewords provide immediate boundaries. Unique decodability is the broader property.
sentences.zh: 前缀码字提供即时边界，而唯一可译是范围更大的性质。

sentences.en: Return to the tree. A short codeword blocks every longer word below that leaf.
sentences.zh: 回到树上。一个短码字会挡住该叶子下面的所有更长码字。

sentences.en: How many short words can we afford? Three one-bit binary words are already impossible.
sentences.zh: 我们能容纳多少个短码字？三个单比特二进制码字就已经不可能。

sentences.en: Kraft inequality turns this limited tree space into a precise length budget.
sentences.zh: Kraft 不等式把有限的树空间转成精确的码长预算。

scenes.title: Tree leaves occupy disjoint descendant slots

sentences.en: Represent each binary codeword as a path from the root of a binary tree.
sentences.zh: 将每个二进制码字表示为二叉树根部出发的一条路径。

sentences.en: A codeword of length l ends at depth l.
sentences.zh: 长度为l的码字终止于深度l。

sentences.en: Prefix-free codewords end at leaves with no ancestor among code leaves.
sentences.zh: 前缀码字对应的叶节点之间不存在祖先关系。

sentences.en: Choose a common depth L at least as large as every codeword length.
sentences.zh: 选取公共深度L，使其不小于所有码字长度。

sentences.en: Expand each leaf downward until depth L.
sentences.zh: 将每个叶节点向下展开至深度L。

sentences.en: A leaf at depth l reserves how many slots at the common depth L?
sentences.zh: 深度为 l 的叶子，会在公共深度 L 预留多少个位置？

sentences.en: It reserves two to L minus l slots. Different prefix leaves reserve disjoint sets.
sentences.zh: 它预留二的 L 减 l 次方个位置。不同前缀叶子预留的集合互不相交。

sentences.en: The full tree has only two to L nodes at that depth.
sentences.zh: 整棵树在该深度只有2^L个节点。

sentences.en: Therefore the sum of two to L minus l i is at most two to L.
sentences.zh: 因此Σᵢ2^(L−lᵢ)≤2^L。

sentences.en: Divide by two to L to obtain the binary Kraft inequality.
sentences.zh: 两边除以2^L，得到二进制Kraft不等式。

sentences.en: The sum over i of two to negative l i is at most one.
This proves necessity for prefix-free code lengths.
sentences.zh: 这证明了前缀码长度的必要条件。

sentences.en: For integer lengths, the condition is also sufficient: some prefix code can realize them.
sentences.zh: 对于整数码长，这个条件也充分：存在某个前缀码能实现它们。

sentences.en: Sort the requested lengths from shortest to longest.
sentences.zh: 将指定长度按从短到长排序。

sentences.en: Use half-open dyadic intervals in the unit interval, ordered from left to right.
sentences.zh: 在单位区间内，使用从左到右排列的半开二进制区间。

sentences.en: A length l corresponds to an interval of width two to negative l.
sentences.zh: 长度l对应宽度为2^(−l)的区间。

sentences.en: Kraft ensures the intervals can be placed without exceeding total width one.
sentences.zh: Kraft条件保证区间可放置且总宽度不超过一。

sentences.en: At each requested length, earlier intervals have widths that are integer multiples of the current width.
sentences.zh: 每次分配时，先前区间宽度都是当前宽度的整数倍。

sentences.en: Place the next interval immediately after the total width already assigned.
sentences.zh: 将新区间紧接在已分配总宽度之后放置。

sentences.en: The Kraft sum guarantees this endpoint never exceeds one.
sentences.zh: Kraft和保证该端点不会超过一。

sentences.en: Write each left endpoint in exactly l binary digits, padding trailing zeros when necessary.
sentences.zh: 将每个左端点写成恰好l位二进制小数，必要时补末尾零。

sentences.en: Intervals do not overlap, so no assigned word prefixes another.
sentences.zh: 区间互不重叠，因此没有码字会成为另一者前缀。

sentences.en: This constructs a prefix code with the requested lengths.
sentences.zh: 这样就构造出具有指定长度的前缀码。

sentences.en: The tree and interval constructions describe the same dyadic structure.
sentences.zh: 树构造与区间构造描述的是同一二进制结构。

sentences.en: For a D-ary code, each node has D children.
sentences.zh: 对D元码，每个节点有D个子节点。

sentences.en: At depth L, there are D to L descendants.
sentences.zh: 深度L共有D^L个后代。

sentences.en: A leaf of depth l occupies D to L minus l slots.
sentences.zh: 深度l的叶占据D^(L−l)个格位。

sentences.en: The resulting condition is sum D to negative l i at most one.
sentences.zh: 于是得到ΣᵢD^(−lᵢ)≤1。

sentences.en: The construction uses base D intervals in place of binary intervals.
sentences.zh: 这一构造使用D进制区间来替代二进制区间。

sentences.en: Kraft tests whether lengths can support some prefix code, not whether chosen labels already do.
sentences.zh: Kraft 判断码长能否容纳某个前缀码，而不保证选定的标签已经满足前缀性质。

sentences.en: A particular code may use more average bits than necessary.
sentences.zh: 某个具体码的平均比特数仍可能不是最小。

sentences.en: McMillan extends the same necessary length bound to every uniquely decodable code.
sentences.zh: McMillan将同一个必要长度界推广到所有唯一可译码。

sentences.en: Its proof counts concatenated codewords rather than tree leaves.
sentences.zh: 其证明统计码字串接结果，而非树叶。

sentences.en: Next, group these concatenations by total length.
sentences.zh: 接下来按总长度对这些串接分组。

sentences.en: Unused space corresponds to branches that need no codeword.
sentences.zh: 未使用空间对应无需码字的树枝。

scenes.title: Unique parsing bounds the number of long concatenations

sentences.en: Consider a finite uniquely decodable code with nonempty codewords.
sentences.zh: 考虑一个码字非空的有限唯一可译码。

sentences.en: Let l i be the length of codeword i.
sentences.zh: 令lᵢ表示第i个码字的长度。

sentences.en: Define K as the sum of D to negative l i.
sentences.zh: 定义K=ΣᵢD^(−lᵢ)。

sentences.en: We will prove K is at most one.
sentences.zh: 我们将证明K≤1。

sentences.en: Concatenate exactly k codewords in every possible ordered sequence.
sentences.zh: 枚举所有恰由k个码字组成的有序串接。

sentences.en: Let A j count those sequences whose total length is j.
sentences.zh: 令Aⱼ表示总长度为j的串接数量。

sentences.en: Unique decodability makes every such concatenated string distinct.
sentences.zh: 唯一可译性保证这些串接字符串互不相同。

sentences.en: There are only D to j strings of length j.
sentences.zh: 长度为j的字符串总共只有D^j个。

sentences.en: Hence A j is at most D to j.
sentences.zh: 所以Aⱼ≤D^j。

sentences.en: Expand K to the k-th power as a sum over all k-codeword sequences.
sentences.zh: 将K的k次方展开为所有k码字序列的求和。

sentences.en: A sequence with total length j contributes D to negative j.
sentences.zh: 总长度为j的序列贡献D^(−j)。

sentences.en: Grouping equal total lengths gives K to k equals sum over j of A j D to negative j.
sentences.zh: 按总长度分组得K^k=ΣⱼAⱼD^(−j)。

sentences.en: The smallest possible total length is k times l minimum.
sentences.zh: 最小总长度为kl_min。

sentences.en: The largest is k times l maximum.
sentences.zh: 最大总长度为kl_max。

sentences.en: There are at most k times the difference of these lengths plus one integer values of j.
sentences.zh: 可能的整数j至多有k(l_max−l_min)+1个。

sentences.en: Each grouped term A j D to negative j is at most one.
sentences.zh: 每个分组项AⱼD^(−j)都至多为一。

sentences.en: The bound is k times the difference between maximum and minimum code lengths, plus one.
sentences.zh: 因此K^k≤k(l_max−l_min)+1。

sentences.en: Take the k-th root. Does this bound still leave a positive gap above one as k grows?
sentences.zh: 取 k 次方根。随着 k 增大，这个界与一之间还会留下正的间隙吗？

sentences.en: The root of this linear expression tends to one as k grows.
sentences.zh: 该线性表达式的k次方根随k增大趋于一。

sentences.en: Thus K is at most one.
sentences.zh: 因此K≤1。

sentences.en: This is McMillan inequality for uniquely decodable codes.
sentences.zh: 这就是唯一可译码的McMillan不等式。

sentences.en: Unique parsing is essential because it makes concatenations distinct.
sentences.zh: 唯一解析至关重要，因为它保证串接结果彼此不同。

sentences.en: Without unique decodability, a length group can contain more messages than there are distinct encoded strings.
sentences.zh: 缺少唯一可译码性时，一个长度分组的消息数可能超过不同编码串的数量。

sentences.en: This proof does not assume a prefix tree.
sentences.zh: 这个证明不假设前缀树结构。

sentences.en: It applies to any finite uniquely decodable code.
sentences.zh: 它适用于任意有限唯一可译码。

sentences.en: For binary codes, set D equal to two.
sentences.zh: 对二进制码，令D=2。

sentences.en: Then the same sum of two to negative lengths is bounded by one.
sentences.zh: 此时同一个长度负指数和仍不超过一。

sentences.en: Prefix codes satisfy Kraft directly by tree counting.
sentences.zh: 前缀码可直接由树计数得到Kraft界。

sentences.en: McMillan shows that unique decodability alone implies it too.
sentences.zh: McMillan证明仅唯一可译性也蕴含该不等式。

sentences.en: The two theorems provide necessity for different code classes.
sentences.zh: 两个定理分别为不同码类提供必要条件。

sentences.en: The factor K to the k expands by choosing one codeword for each position.
sentences.zh: K^k的展开对应每个位置各选一个码字。

sentences.en: Multiplying their weights adds their lengths in the exponent.
sentences.zh: 权重相乘会使指数中的长度相加。

sentences.en: All possible j values lie between the minimum and maximum total lengths.
sentences.zh: 所有可能的j都位于最小与最大总长度之间。

sentences.en: The number of these integer lengths grows only linearly with k.
sentences.zh: 这些整数长度的数量仅随k线性增长。

sentences.en: Next, convert a length list into a probability distribution.
sentences.zh: 接下来将长度列表转换成概率分布。

scenes.chapter: Entropy lower bound on average length
scenes.title: Kraft slack and divergence separate cleanly

sentences.en: Take a finite uniquely decodable code for the positive-probability source symbols.
sentences.zh: 考虑定义在正概率信源符号上的有限唯一可译码。

sentences.en: Write p i for source probability and l i for code length.
sentences.zh: 用pᵢ表示信源概率，用lᵢ表示码长。

sentences.en: Every source symbol in this support receives a codeword.
sentences.zh: 该支持集中的每个信源符号都有对应码字。

sentences.en: Define average length L as the sum of p i times l i.
sentences.zh: 定义平均码长L=Σᵢpᵢlᵢ。

sentences.en: Let K be the Kraft sum over the codewords.
sentences.zh: 令K表示这些码字的Kraft和。

sentences.en: Kraft or McMillan gives zero less than K at most one.
sentences.zh: Kraft或McMillan不等式给出0<K≤1。

sentences.en: Define q i as D to negative l i divided by K.
sentences.zh: 定义qᵢ=D^(−lᵢ)/K。

sentences.en: These q values are positive and sum to one.
sentences.zh: 这些qᵢ均为正且总和为一。

sentences.en: The source probabilities p i are also positive on the chosen support.
sentences.zh: 所选支持集上的信源概率pᵢ也均为正。

sentences.en: So the divergence from P to q is finite.
sentences.zh: 因此从P到q的散度有限。

sentences.en: Expand divergence as the sum p i log D of p i over q i.
sentences.zh: 将散度展开为Σᵢpᵢlog_D(pᵢ/qᵢ)。

sentences.en: Substitute q i equals D to negative l i over K.
sentences.zh: 代入qᵢ=D^(−lᵢ)/K。

sentences.en: Its logarithm becomes log D p i plus l i plus log D K.
sentences.zh: 其对数变为log_Dpᵢ+lᵢ+log_DK。

sentences.en: Average the first term to get negative source entropy, measured using logarithm base D.
sentences.zh: 对第一项求平均，得到以D为对数底的负信源熵。

sentences.en: Average the second term to get L.
sentences.zh: 对第二项求平均得到L。

sentences.en: The final constant remains log D K.
sentences.zh: 最后的常数项为log_DK。

sentences.en: Therefore divergence equals L minus H plus log D K.
sentences.zh: 因此D(P∥q)=L−H+log_DK。

sentences.en: Rearrange to obtain L equals H plus divergence minus log D K.
sentences.zh: 整理得L=H+D_D(P∥q)−log_DK。

sentences.en: Divergence is nonnegative.
sentences.zh: 散度非负。

sentences.en: Since K is at most one, negative log D K is also nonnegative.
sentences.zh: 由于K≤1，−log_DK也非负。

sentences.en: Therefore L is at least H.
sentences.zh: 因此L≥H。

sentences.en: When can average length equal entropy? Which two gaps must close?
sentences.zh: 平均码长何时等于熵？哪两个间隙必须消失？

sentences.en: The divergence vanishes exactly when p equals q.
sentences.zh: 散度为零当且仅当p=q。

sentences.en: The Kraft penalty vanishes exactly when K equals one.
sentences.zh: Kraft惩罚为零当且仅当K=1。

sentences.en: So equality requires K equal one and p i equal q i for every symbol.
sentences.zh: 所以等号要求K=1且每个符号均有pᵢ=qᵢ。

sentences.en: If an original source symbol has probability zero, omit it from this support calculation.
sentences.zh: 若原信源符号概率为零，就从本次支持集计算中略去。

sentences.en: No logarithm of zero is needed.
sentences.zh: 这样无需计算零的对数。

sentences.en: A codeword for an impossible symbol can only increase Kraft usage.
sentences.zh: 不可能符号的码字只会增加Kraft占用。

sentences.en: The bound applies to binary bits when D equals two.
sentences.zh: 令D=2时，该界即适用于二进制比特。

sentences.en: For other alphabets, lengths and entropy use the same logarithm base D.
sentences.zh: 对其他字母表，码长与熵使用同一对数底D。

sentences.en: The inequality is a lower bound, not a claim every code attains it.
sentences.zh: 该不等式只是下界，并不表示每个码都能达到。

sentences.en: Integer lengths usually prevent exact probability matching.
sentences.zh: 整数码长通常无法精确匹配概率。

sentences.en: A ceiling construction will bound the extra average length by one code-alphabet digit.
sentences.zh: 向上取整构造将把平均码长开销限制在一个码字母符号以内。

sentences.en: Changing the logarithm base changes both entropy and length units together.
sentences.zh: 改变对数底会同时改变熵与码长的计量单位。

sentences.en: For binary codewords, the unit is bits.
sentences.zh: 对二进制码字，单位是比特。

sentences.en: The divergence comparison is valid because q has positive probability wherever p does.
sentences.zh: 由于p为正处q也为正，散度比较有定义。

scenes.title: Rounding costs less than one bit per block

sentences.en: With at least two positive-probability symbols, how much can rounding ideal lengths cost?
sentences.zh: 至少有两个正概率符号时，把理想码长向上取整会付出多大代价？

sentences.en: For each positive-probability symbol, set l i to ceiling of negative log two p i.
sentences.zh: 对每个正概率符号，令lᵢ=⌈−log₂pᵢ⌉。

sentences.en: These are finite positive integer lengths.
sentences.zh: 这些长度都是有限正整数。

sentences.en: Because ceiling rounds upward, l i is at least negative log two p i.
sentences.zh: 由于向上取整，lᵢ≥−log₂pᵢ。

sentences.en: Negate both sides and exponentiate base two.
sentences.zh: 两边取负并以2为底取幂。

sentences.en: This gives two to negative l i at most p i.
sentences.zh: 由此得2^(−lᵢ)≤pᵢ。

sentences.en: Summing over symbols gives Kraft sum at most one.
sentences.zh: 对所有符号求和得到Kraft和不超过一。

sentences.en: The converse construction from the previous chapter builds a prefix code.
sentences.zh: 上一章的逆向构造可据此建立前缀码。

sentences.en: Rounding moves each ideal length upward. How large can that extra distance be?
sentences.zh: 取整把每个理想码长向上推。多出的距离能有多大？

sentences.en: It is strictly less than one. Multiply the lower and upper length bounds by p i.
sentences.zh: 它严格小于一。把码长的上下界乘以 p i。

sentences.en: Sum the lower bounds to obtain entropy at most average length.
sentences.zh: 对下界求和得到熵不超过平均码长。

sentences.en: Sum the upper bounds and use total probability one.
sentences.zh: 对上界求和，并利用总概率为一。

sentences.en: The result is average length strictly below entropy plus one bit.
sentences.zh: 结果是平均码长严格小于熵加一比特。

sentences.en: Thus H is at most L, and L is less than H plus one.
sentences.zh: 因此H≤L<H+1。

sentences.en: This is a guarantee for the Shannon length construction.
sentences.zh: 这是Shannon长度构造的保证。

sentences.en: It does not say every arbitrary code is optimal.
sentences.zh: 它不表示任意码都最优。

sentences.en: Now encode blocks of n independent, identically distributed source symbols as super-symbols.
sentences.zh: 现在将n个独立同分布的信源符号组成的块视为超符号编码。

sentences.en: A block probability is the product of its n symbol probabilities.
sentences.zh: 块概率等于其中n个符号概率之积。

sentences.en: Its negative log probability is the sum of their surprisals.
sentences.zh: 其负对数概率等于各符号自信息之和。

sentences.en: Taking expectation gives block entropy n H.
sentences.zh: 取期望得到块熵nH。

sentences.en: Apply Shannon lengths to the block alphabet.
sentences.zh: 对块字母表应用Shannon长度构造。

sentences.en: Its expected code length is at least n H and less than n H plus one.
sentences.zh: 其期望码长至少为nH且严格小于nH+1。

sentences.en: Divide by n to obtain a per-symbol overhead below one over n bit.
sentences.zh: 除以n，得到每符号开销小于1/n比特。

sentences.en: As n grows, that rounding overhead tends to zero.
sentences.zh: n增大时，取整开销趋于零。

sentences.en: The block code still needs a prefix construction.
sentences.zh: 块码仍需通过前缀构造实现。

sentences.en: Kraft sufficiency supplies such a code for the integer block lengths.
sentences.zh: Kraft充分性可为这些整数块长构造相应码。

sentences.en: For a single positive-probability symbol, the formula gives length zero.
sentences.zh: 若只有一个正概率符号，该公式会给出零长度。

sentences.en: For a known fixed block, there is only one possible message. It needs no bits.
sentences.zh: 对于长度已知的固定块，只有一种可能消息，因此不需要比特。

sentences.en: But for an unknown-length stream, how many source symbols does silence contain?
sentences.zh: 但在长度未知的流中，一段沉默包含多少个信源符号？

sentences.en: Repeated empty words cannot reveal how many symbols were sent.
sentences.zh: 重复空码字无法揭示发送了多少个符号。

sentences.en: A one-symbol nonempty code has length at least one.
sentences.zh: 单符号非空码的码长至少为一。

sentences.en: The strict H plus one Shannon bound is stated for at least two positive symbols.
sentences.zh: 严格的H加一Shannon界针对至少两个正概率符号。

sentences.en: For a fixed n-symbol block from a deterministic source, one known message needs no bits.
sentences.zh: 对确定信源的已知n符号块，唯一消息无需比特。

sentences.en: That exception does not license empty codewords for ordinary variable-length coding.
sentences.zh: 这一例外并不允许普通变长编码使用空码字。

sentences.en: Next, compare Shannon coding with Huffman and universal constructions.
sentences.zh: 下一集将比较Shannon编码、Huffman编码与通用构造。
